description: This file defines the class SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport, a generic DAO support class for JPA-based persistence operations including entity retrieval, update, delete, query building, and transaction management.

classes.name: SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport
classes.description: A generic DAO support class providing CRUD operations, query building, and transaction management for JPA entities.

methods.name: buildTypedQuery
methods.description: Creates a TypedQuery from criteria with optional limit and offset

methods.name: filterCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Applies a filter expression to a criteria query if not null

methods.name: rootCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Creates and returns the root of a criteria query for a given entity class

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by primary key

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by a specified field value

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an entity, merging if detached

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an entity from persistence context

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database

methods.name: listEntity
methods.description: Lists entities based on optional filters, ordering, limit, and offset

methods.name: listEntityByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specified field value

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Counts total entities of a class

methods.name: countEntityByField
methods.description: Counts entities filtered by a specified field value

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Executes a criteria query or typed query and returns single result or null if none found
